source.note: Composed from the `card-created` schema example for this event in Lithic's OpenAPI spec (https://github.com/lithic-com/lithic-openapi/blob/53e650d62efc04c85eccfa794629563ce865fe4d/lithic-openapi.yml), which the reference page renders. The webhook's request body is `allOf` the `event_type` const `card.created` and that schema, so `event_type` was added first; every other value is as printed.
